ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with HIST 495, Section: A. Title: US Gender and Sexuality Topic: This course focuses on the history of gender and sexuality in the United States. We will explore the construction of the fields of women's, gender, and sexuality history as we read seminal work that has built and transformed scholarship. The course also examines how scholars have treated the category of race as part of their analytical framework for studying gender and sexuality. Students will learn the necessary skills to conduct original research, present on the outcome, and write a long paper based on their archival work.
